summary: The old harness discards generated HTML on both source versions. It can select the new spoiler flag through fuzz input, so flag selection is not a separate blocker.

claims.necessity_reason: HTML delivery is part of md_html's operational surface. A finite input can produce ordinary rendered HTML, but the harness callback discards every output chunk and provides no equivalent output route.

before.requirement: For Markdown containing an emphasis span, md_html must deliver the generated HTML through its output callback.
before.reason: The renderer supports emphasis tags, while the old callback returns without retaining the delivered text.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The renderer emits HTML tags for an ordinary emphasis span.

after.requirement: For Markdown containing an emphasis span, md_html must deliver the generated HTML through its output callback.
after.reason: The same output callback remains the renderer's delivery interface, and the old harness still discards its text.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Ordinary emphasis rendering remains supported after the change.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The entry passes that callback to its sole md_html invocation.

claims.comparison_reason: The same ordinary HTML output obligation and the same no-op callback exist on both sides.

claims.necessity_reason: The changed renderer supports spoiler HTML for a finite flagged input. The harness can select the flag, but its output callback discards the generated tags.

before.requirement: Deliver HTML spoiler tags for a flagged ||text|| span.
before.reason: The complete prior span enum and renderer switch have no spoiler span contract.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete prior opening-tag switch has no spoiler case.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS and a ||text|| span, deliver the generated <x-spoiler> tags through md_html's output callback.
after.reason: The source adds spoiler span recognition and opening and closing HTML tags. Input bytes can set the new flag, but the old callback discards the tags.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Collects a double-pipe delimiter when the flag is set.
Analyzes the collected double-pipe marks as spoiler spans.
Dispatches resolved spoiler spans to renderer callbacks.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The first input word can select parser flags, including the new bit; the same call uses the discarding callback.

claims.comparison_reason: Spoiler HTML delivery becomes applicable after the change. Its output is lost through the old callback; flag selection itself is reachable.

missing_information: The complete md_process_all_blocks call path in src/md4c.c is needed to certify exhaustive control-flow coverage for the selected changes.
